purpose: Teach: 供養/守護/物色/不特定/贈与/再婚/勝訴/虚構

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の供養に警察、配慮されてますね
lines.en: I notice the police have been thoughtful in arranging a proper memorial for the victim in this case.
lines.style: Measured, formal. Slight pause before speaking—choosing words with care. Respectful tone, acknowledging gravity. Not quite deferential, but genuinely thoughtful.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域の守護を任務として誇りに思っております
lines.en: The police take pride in our duty to protect and serve this community.
lines.style: Clear and steady. Professional register. Light emphasis on 'duty'—not defensive, but grounded. Measured pace, like delivering prepared conviction rather than reading.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者が現場を物色していた事を警察、確認されましたね
lines.en: I understand the police have confirmed the suspect was surveying the location beforehand.
lines.style: Quiet inquiry underneath. Thoughtful phrasing—not accusatory, genuinely seeking to understand. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不特定多数を狙う事件に厳しく対応します
lines.en: The police respond with severity to crimes targeting random members of the public.
lines.style: Formal, declarative. Strength in the tone without aggression. Emphasis falls on the seriousness of the crime category itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不正贈与の事案も警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: And I see the police are also investigating the illegal financial transfers connected to this case.
lines.style: Careful, precise. Building understanding aloud. Slight upward inflection on 'also'—connecting dots methodically, not accusingly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、再婚後のDV事案にも対応します
lines.en: The police are prepared to address domestic violence cases even in situations of remarriage.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. Matter-of-fact delivery. No hedging—direct statement of scope and readiness. Professional clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、勝訴できる証拠を集められてますね
lines.en: It seems the police have been able to gather solid evidence to support the case.
lines.style: Quiet approval in the tone. Observational rather than questioning. Slight nod in the voice. Careful not to presume, but genuinely impressed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査結果が虚構と疑われないよう厳格に進めます
lines.en: The police conduct this investigation with rigorous standards to ensure the findings cannot be questioned as fabrication.
lines.style: Formal, emphatic. Careful precision on 'rigorous standards.' Slow pace. The tone of someone stating foundational commitment—not defensive, but deliberate.
